fullContentHtml:
UPSC NDA/ NA-I Final Result 2026 – Full Details

Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the final result for the post of National Defence Academy NDA & Naval Academy NA Exam 2026 on the official website of UPSC. This recruitment was released for 394 posts. Applications for the UPSC NDA/ NA-I Recruitment 2026 were accepted from December 10, 2025, to December 30, 2025. The written examination was held on 12 April 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UPSC NDA/ NA-I Final Result 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 10 December 2025
  • Last Date : 30 December 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 30 December 2025
  • Exam Date : 12 April 2026
  • Admit Card Released : 1 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 16 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 08 May 2026
  • Result : 08 May 2026
  • Name Wise Result : 13 May 2026
  • Final Result : 05 November 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is UPSC NDA/ NA-I Final Result 2026?

UPSC NDA/ NA-I Final Result 2026 is the official result announcement. Candidates can check their scorecard and merit status via the direct link above.

Where can I find the official direct link?

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
